content:
All 10 recent Red Sea Parts orders share the same truncated layout ("Amount: NNN..." with no VAT/total fields), spanning t=505–518, and every retry-budget violation (E1, E13) is exclusively from this supplier. No internal deploy (E6, E7) or config change explains the onset. Ledger/sync-job data is healthy (E14). The fault is entirely external.
